name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
summary: This unit focuses on the theoretical and practical aspects of artificial intelligence and machine learning, including algorithm development, data analysis, and applications in various domains.

name: Computational Biology
summary: This unit applies computational methods to biological problems, such as genomics, proteomics, and systems biology, to advance our understanding of living organisms.

name: Quantum Computing Research Group
summary: Dedicated to exploring the principles and applications of quantum computing, this group investigates quantum algorithms, hardware development, and error correction techniques.
